meta.title: Session Handoff
meta.description: Live session start time, accumulated work time, and conversation turn count, with a work-time panel for start, last turn end, and total work time; when a configurable turn limit is reached, the model writes a handoff file and the task continues in a new session named “<source title> 第N次交接” inside the same workspace. A manually triggered handoff reports the next step and waits for your confirmation before continuing.
